source.document: ECC Recommendation T/R 25-08: Planning criteria and cross-border coordination of frequencies for land mobile systems in the range 29.7-470 MHz
source.edition: Edition 6 June 2025 (approved 15 January 1990, latest amended 6 June 2025)
source.section: Annex 1, A1.2.3 Indicative coordination thresholds for analogue or digital land mobile systems

criterion.time_percentage_note: Footnote 2 of A1.2.3: in certain situations the 1% time curves should be used for digital systems, e.g. to better protect analogue systems. Not applied by default (no organizer instruction); 10% time is used.

bandwidth_correction.formula: BC = 10 x log10(channel spacing / 25 kHz) dB, added to the threshold for channel spacing greater than 25 kHz
bandwidth_correction.condition: Valid when the spectral power distribution within the channel spacing is uniform; otherwise the threshold applies within every 25 kHz. AstraSync uses the notified bandwidth as the channel spacing and records uniform distribution as an assumption.

challenge_extension_above_470_mhz.basis: Since AI 2026 Traficom challenge organizer clarification: the general land-mobile criterion for the band above 400 MHz may be applied to IFIC 3076 land-mobile records above 470 MHz. This is a challenge-specific extension, not normative coverage of T/R 25-08 (whose scope ends at 470 MHz).

approval.approved_by: SCP619 (AstraSync team lead), applying the Traficom challenge organizers' clarification

criterion.interpretation: An indicative coordination threshold: a field strength above it at the border means the assignment should not be brought into use without coordination with Finland. Exceeding it is a coordination concern, not harmful interference and not non-compliance.

stage_c_geography.basis: Great-circle distance to the nearest vertex of the Natural Earth 1:10m Finland boundary; mobile areas reduced by their notified radius.

assumptions: No terrain database: terrain clearance angle, tropospheric scatter and terminal terrain heights are not applied (P.1546-6 Annex 5 steps 12, 13 skipped).
Field strength exceeded for the stated percentage of time and locations; not a worst case.
e.r.p. is taken as the value toward the receiver; no antenna pattern is applied unless the scenario's e.r.p. already includes it.
Effective height heff assumed equal to antenna height ha.
Receiver clutter height 10.0 m: the reference implementation's typical value for Rural.
Power basis: e.r.p. as notified (RR 1.162).
